English.name: Pipe Bird
English.desc: Move the head up and down to control the bird's flight height and avoid the pipes.

ChineseSimplified.name: 水管小鸟
ChineseSimplified.desc: 上下移动头部，控制小鸟飞行高度，躲避水管。

ChineseTraditional.name: 水管小鳥
ChineseTraditional.desc: 上下移動頭部，控制小鳥飛行高度，躲避水管。

English.name: Gold Miner
English.desc: Aim at the location of the ore and squat to fire the grappling hook.

ChineseSimplified.name: 黄金矿工
ChineseSimplified.desc: 看准矿石位置，下蹲发射抓钩

ChineseTraditional.name: 黄金礦工
ChineseTraditional.desc: 看準礦石位置，下蹲發射抓鉤。

English.name: Cut the Fruit
English.desc: Swipe your finger across to slice the fruits. The more combos you make, the higher your score will be. Be careful not to hit the bombs!

ChineseSimplified.name: 切水果
ChineseSimplified.desc: 单手划过切开水果，连击越多得分越高。注意，不要切中炸弹！

ChineseTraditional.name: 切水果
ChineseTraditional.desc: 单手劃過切開水果，連擊越多得分越高。注意，不要切中炸彈！

English.name: Whack-A-Mole
English.desc: Watch out for the moles and hit them with the punch mitt. Be careful not to hit the bombs!

ChineseSimplified.name: 打地鼠
ChineseSimplified.desc: 看准地鼠，用拳套敲击。注意，不要击打炸弹！

ChineseTraditional.name: 打地鼠
ChineseTraditional.desc: 看準地鼠，用拳套敲擊。注意，不要擊打炸彈！

English.name: Crazy Cave
English.desc: Control the miner by moving left and right, and jump to release the ultimate skill when the energy bar is full.

ChineseSimplified.name: 疯狂洞穴
ChineseSimplified.desc: 左右移动控制矿工，必杀技能量槽满时跳跃释放。

ChineseTraditional.name: 瘋狂洞穴
ChineseTraditional.desc: 左右移動控制礦工，必殺技能量槽滿時跳躍釋放。！

English.name: Fruit Merging
English.desc: Move left and right to control the position of the fruit; squat or throw down with both hands to put down the fruit.

ChineseSimplified.name: 合成大西瓜
ChineseSimplified.desc: 左右移动控制水果位置，下蹲或双手向下扔，放下水果。

ChineseTraditional.name: 合成大西瓜
ChineseTraditional.desc: 左右移動控制水果位置；下蹲或雙手向下扔，放下水果。

English.name: Space Flight
English.desc: Move left and right to control the astronaut's direction

ChineseSimplified.name: 太空飞行
ChineseSimplified.desc: 左右移动来控制宇航员的方向

ChineseTraditional.name: 太空飛行
ChineseTraditional.desc: 左右移動來控制宇航員的方向

English.name: Kill Calories
English.desc: Move left and right to control the character`s position; lift both hands above the head to lift the barbell plates; then throw down with both hands to release them.

ChineseSimplified.name: 消灭卡路里
ChineseSimplified.desc: 左右移动控制角色位置；双手举过头顶，控制角色举起杠铃片；然后双手向下扔，丢出杠铃片。

ChineseTraditional.name: 消滅卡路里
ChineseTraditional.desc: 左右移動控制角色位置；雙手舉過頭頂，控制角色舉起杠鈴片；然後雙手向下丟，丟出杠鈴片。

English.name: Please stand 1.5 meters in front of the sports mirror and raise your hands horizontally to start the game

ChineseSimplified.name: 请站在运动镜前1.5米，平举双手启动游戏

ChineseTraditional.name: 請站在運動鏡前1.5米，平舉雙手啓動遊戲
